name: Harappan
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Unattested/undeciphered (Indus script); no phonological description of the language exists.

sources.citation: Davletshin, A.I. & Belyaev, D.D. 2010. Xarappskij jazyk [Harappan]. In: Kazansky N.N., Kibrik A.A., Koryakov Yu.B. (eds.), Jazyki mira: Drevnie reliktovye jazyki Perednej Azii, 187-196. Moskva: Academia. (whole volume PDF, 241 pp., open on iling-ran.ru)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 5.1.0 'Fonologicheskie svedenija' (p. 192) says only that no phonetic reading of any Harappan sign has been established ('до сих пор, в строгом смысле этого слова, не установлено фонетическое чтение ни одного знака'); no phoneme inventory, no prosody. The rest of the linguistic part (5.2) is sign-order morphology inferred from the undeciphered texts.
